verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents attaching scorers to tasks, where code checks concrete outputs or recorded changes. Scorers return 0–1 values with configurable pass thresholds, and they are versioned and frozen with each evaluation run. This covers the core of writing custom code-based scorers. missing for 10: detail on how custom scorer code is authored (languages, SDK/API surface, examples), support for custom aggregate metrics beyond per-check scores, independent or hands-on corroboration.
